extracted.name: Crispy chickpea stuffed wraps
extracted.description: Make our faff-free traybake kebab and use the leftovers as the base to make these wraps, filled with leftover lamb, hummus, peppers and chickpeas
ingredient_lines: 150g leftover traybake lamb kebab roughly chopped (see step 2)
instruction_lines: To make quick pickled onions, tip the vinegar, sugar and 1 tsp sea salt into a saucepan, bring to a boil and leave to simmer for a few minutes until dissolved. Stir in the red onions and set aside to pickle for at least 30 mins. Will keep chilled for up to one week.

Heat the air fryer to 200C or oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Stir together the chickpeas, oil, harissa and lamb until well coated then tip into the air fryer basket or onto a baking tray and cook for 10 mins.
Divide and spread the hummus over each tortilla and top with the pepper, salad leaves, pickled onions, chickpeas and lamb.
